name: Franklin Soccer School (FSS) Summer Programs
description_short: Four-day indoor soccer sessions in July and August for multiple age groups, with fun skill games, a focus on technical skills and a Smart Soccer World Cup theme. Held at Downtown Sports, an air-conditioned facility in Franklin; every player gets a ball and t-shirt. Club/Advanced sessions are offered for more focused players.
